scope: Proposition 7.9 (Cap constants before exterior choices) of the manuscript “Purely cosmetic surgery on knots in the three-sphere” (preprints/Purely-Cosmetic-Surgery-on-Knots-in-the-Three-Sphere-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 306 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ee916c92b825a868), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 90. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each old cap W there is a metric, unchanged on its rational end collars, and a number CW < ∞ such that ∀ P ∃ LP, δP > 0 : isolation at least LP, admissible errors at most δP =⇒ no cap-containing R and (7.5). Here P is any fixed finite exterior problem whose restriction to W is the fixed cap datum. Neither CW nor that metric depends on the new exceptional evaluation or the number of intervals. The thresholds and intermediate full-curvature bounds may depend on both.
